abstract: Differentiation of mouse embryonal carcinoma cells to the parietal endoderm phenotype is associated with expression of PTH-responsive adenylate cyclase. A PTH-like protein (PLP), which binds to PTH receptors and activates adenylate cyclase in classical PTH target cells was recently isolated and cloned. We assessed whether the parietal endoderm phenotype is associated with the expression of PLP or its receptor. A 1.4-kilobase PLP transcript was detected in the mouse parietal endoderm cell line PYS-2. No hybridizing transcripts were evident in undifferentiated mouse embryonal carcinoma cells PSA-1 or F9. However, differentiation of these cells to parietal endoderm, either spontaneously (PSA-1) or by treatment with retinoic acid and dibutyryl cAMP (F9), resulted in expression of the 1.4-kilobase PLP message. Undifferentiated F9 cells displayed negligible specific binding of [125I]PLP-(1-34)amide. When F9 cells were induced to differentiate to parietal endoderm, specific binding sites for [125I]PLP-(1-34)amide were expressed in parallel with PLP-responsive adenylate cyclase. These receptors, like those in classical PTH target tissues, displayed identical affinity (Kd = 5.2 nM) for bPTH-(1-34) and hPLP-(1-34)amide; with binding capacity (Bmax) of 6.6 x 10(4) sites/cell. In the presence of retinoic acid, exogenous PLP substituted for dibutyryl cAMP in a concentration-dependent fashion in promoting the differentiation of F9 cells to parietal endoderm. Thus, both PLP mRNA and PLP receptors coupled to adenylate cyclase are expressed during the differentiation of mouse embryonal carcinoma cells. Increased cAMP levels produced by autocrine stimulation of PLP receptors by PLP may contribute to differentiation of embryonal carcinoma cells into parietal endoderm.
abstract_ja: 副甲状腺ホルモン様蛋白(PLP)は、古典的PTH標的細胞でPTH受容体に結合しアデニル酸シクラーゼを活性化するタンパク質として単離・クローニングされた。マウス壁側内胚葉細胞株PYS-2では、1.4キロベースのPLP転写産物が検出された。未分化のマウス胎児性癌細胞PSA-1およびF9ではハイブリダイズする転写産物は認められなかった。しかし、PSA-1は自然に、F9はレチノイン酸とジブチリルcAMPの処理により壁側内胚葉へ分化すると、PLPの1.4キロベース転写産物が発現した。未分化F9細胞では[125I]PLP-(1-34)アミドの特異的結合はほとんど認められなかったが、壁側内胚葉へ分化誘導すると、PLP応答性アデニル酸シクラーゼ活性と並行して特異的結合部位が発現した。これらの受容体は古典的PTH標的組織と同様に、bPTH-(1-34)とhPLP-(1-34)アミドに対して同一の親和性(Kd = 5.2 nM)を示し、結合能(Bmax)は6.6×10⁴部位/細胞であった。レチノイン酸存在下では、外因性PLPが濃度依存的にジブチリルcAMPの代わりとなり、F9細胞の壁側内胚葉への分化を促進した。したがって、マウス胎児性癌細胞の分化過程においてPLP mRNAとアデニル酸シクラーゼに共役したPLP受容体の両方が発現する。PLPによる受容体の自己刺激でcAMPが増加し、胎児性癌細胞の壁側内胚葉への分化に寄与する可能性がある。
